blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Banks Collected ₹7,086 Crore in Minimum Average Balance Penalties in FY26. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Private sector banks accounted for 70% of total minimum balance penalties collected.
Penalty Breakdown: Private banks collected ₹4,948.71 crore (HDFC Bank top ₹1,798.14 cr; Axis Bank ₹1,081.33 cr); PSBs collected ₹2,137.92 crore (SBI top ₹477.27 cr).
PSB Exemption: 10 out of 12 PSBs have completely discontinued MAB penal charges.
BSBDA Accounts: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (PMJDY) exempt from minimum balance requirements.
Private bank penalty share (70% / ₹4,948.71 cr) vs PSB share (₹2,137.92 cr).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
